sections.skill: Create a one-variable equation for a situation with a negative rate

questions.skill: Create a one-variable equation for a situation with a negative rate
questions.standard_level: High school (Common Core high-school standard; this bank places it at Grade 9 as a second forward step. This is an instructional choice, not an official grade assignment.)
questions.prompt: A phone battery is at 90% of its full charge. It drops by 6 percentage points of its full capacity each hour. Write and solve an equation to find when it reaches 30%.
questions.prompt_markup:
A phone battery is at 90% of its full charge. It drops by 6 percentage points of its full capacity each hour.
Write and solve an equation to find when it reaches 30%.
questions.correct_answer: The equation 90 - 6h = 30 and the answer h = 10 hours
questions.grading_note: Both parts are required: a valid equation (for example 90 - 6h = 30) and the correct answer, 10 hours. Any valid equation is accepted, but the solution must also be correct.
